Featured / Booking & connected systems

Daybook

A small booking product with a real local workflow: validated requests, a queue, simulated faults and safe recovery.

A request should survive a broken connection.

Daybook makes that requirement visible. Bookings can wait for a connection, move through the system, meet an API or device fault, and replay without duplicate delivery.

The interface, event trail and spatial system react to the same state. Shareable configurations use public settings, not guest names or booking records.
